plain_view.definition: SELECT a.id, a.parent_id FROM a JOIN b ON b.a_id = a.id

lateral_view.definition: SELECT a.id, a.parent_id FROM a LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b.id FROM b WHERE b.a_id = a.id LIMIT 1) related ON true

view_join.definition: SELECT a.id, a.parent_id FROM a JOIN other_view related ON related.a_id = a.id

qualified_star.definition: SELECT a.* FROM a JOIN b ON b.a_id=a.id

renamed.definition: SELECT a.id AS key FROM a JOIN b joined ON joined.a_id=a.id

anonymous_derived.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN (SELECT 1) ON true

nested_exposed.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN (b JOIN a x ON true) ON true

nested_hidden.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN (b JOIN a ON true) grouped ON true

qualified_schema.definition: SELECT public.a.id FROM public.a JOIN audit.a ON true

partial.definition: SELECT a.id, COALESCE(a.parent_id,a.id) AS parent_id FROM a JOIN b ON true

unqualified.definition: SELECT id FROM a JOIN b ON true

unqualified_star.definition: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON true

alias_collision.definition: SELECT base.id FROM a base JOIN b base ON true

table_collision.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN audit.a ON true

derived_collision.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN (SELECT 1) a ON true

nested_collision.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN (b JOIN a ON true) ON true

nested_alias_collision.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN (b JOIN b other ON true) a ON true

unsupported_factor.definition: SELECT a.id FROM a JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[1]) AS x(n) ON true

joined_star_collision.definition: SELECT a.* FROM a JOIN b a ON true

wrong_owner.definition: SELECT missing.id FROM a JOIN b ON true

chained.definition: SELECT v.id FROM plain_view v JOIN b ON true
